_doc: Acts II and III story (docs/STORY.md). Same shape as story.json (merged into it at load): speakers, scenes (place, cast, lines, optional choice), lines (banter + boss lines said in play). 'hero' = the leading player's hero. A choice option's id is the road it opens; its `blurb` is shown under the button. Scenes named in a chapter's bossScene play when that chapter's boss fight starts.

lines: Three villages along the trench have gone quiet. No smoke, no bells. Nothing.
Where she lay, the ground's split open. It breathes. Cold, like a cellar.
She's gone. Aldric's gone. What's left to be afraid of?
Whatever she was lying on, little blade.
You think the first Lamplords chained a wyrm for fun? She wasn't their prisoner. She was the lid.
And you lifted it. Lovely. Rooks, with me.
Shh. Shh. It's talking. It's been talking to me for forty years.
Sexton Marrow? You kept the graves at Greyspire.
I kept them full. It's hungry, you see, and the wyrm sat on its mouth for an age.
Now the mouth is open, and somebody has to set the table.
Aldric only listened to half of it. He heard 'chain the wyrm' and stopped there.
The other half said 'and then I will be free'.
What is it? What's down there?
The Undermaw. Go and see. It will be so pleased to meet you.
He jumped. He just... jumped in.
Then so do we. There are steps cut in the wall. Old ones.
Those aren't rocks. Those are ribs.
Wyrms. Dozens. This whole land used to have them, one under every hill.
It ate them. One by one, for a thousand years. She's the last.
And she flew off without us. Brilliant.
Child. You came down. Of course you did. I taught you that.
Brother? You're... your skin. There are roots in your skin.
It caught me when I fell. It is very kind. It only wants a little of you.
Come here. Let me show you how warm it is.
...The roots let go. I can hear myself again.
I heard it too, child. Years ago. I thought a leash on the wyrm was safer than an open door.
You'd have freed her sooner. You did anyway. You were always better than me.
She's hurt. She flew to Bellwater to die. Ossmara. Her name is Ossmara.
The whole village is under the lake. You can see the bell towers under the water.
And there she is. In the shallows. Look at her side.
...SMALL ONE. YOU CAME. YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE.
There are roots in you. Like Aldric.
IT FOLLOWED ME UP. IT WANTS THE LAST OF US.
The water's moving. Something under it.
The pit's still open behind us, and that hand will grow back.
We have the bell-stones. Their song can do one of two things.
Ring them for her, and they'll heal her. She'll be strong again, and the pit stays open.
Or chain her over the pit, as the old Lamplords did. The mouth shuts. She'll never forgive you.
...THE CHOICE IS YOURS, SMALL ONE. I HAVE MADE ENOUGH OF THEM.

choice.prompt: The bell-stones are in your hands.

options.label: Ring the bells for her
options.blurb: Heal Ossmara. She will fight beside you. The pit stays open.

options.label: Chain her over the pit
options.blurb: Shut the Undermaw's mouth. She will not forgive it.

lines: Listen. The towers under the water are ringing.
THE UNDERMAW WILL CLIMB TO THE CAPITAL. IT WANTS PEOPLE, MANY PEOPLE.
CLIMB ON, SMALL ONE. WE HUNT IT TOGETHER.
The chains are taking. The mouth is shutting.
I'm sorry. It was the only way to shut it.
THEN I WILL BREAK THE WAY.
They're kneeling to you. The Order. They're kneeling to you.
Someone has to hold the chain, Grell.
That's what he said, too. I'm done. Don't follow me.
By order of Queen Isolde: the holder of the lantern is outlaw. Lay it down or be cut down.
I am Orsolya of the Silver. I have killed one Lamplord already this year.
I would rather not make it two. Put it down.
she lies. she wants it for her queen.
The Queen will not let a second Lamplord rise. Not while I breathe.
Aldric. That's Aldric's voice. Inside the glass.
where else would I be, child? I poured myself in as I fell. we are going to do great things.
Turn round. Please. Millbrook came here. We're Rooks now, all of us.
Home is under that thing's shadow every time it flies over. You fly it.
Rooks! Nobody touches the farm-hand. I'll do it myself.
I taught you one trick at the docks. Here's another.
This hook's thrown, not swung. Mind your feet.
kill him and the Rooks scatter.
...weak. then come to the Kiln, where the glass was blown. I will make you strong.
Go on, then. Run to your lamp. We'll be here when it burns you.
The lantern comes home. Every lamp of the Order was blown from this furnace.
And the wyrm? Why is she chained over the roof?
Because the glass needs her heat. Did he not tell you? He tells nobody anything.
He wants to pour you into the glass beside him. Two minds, one leash.
I want the lantern for myself. So, you see, I can't let either of you have it.
...Do it, then. Choose. Everyone has to, in the end.
pour yourself in. the wyrm obeys forever. no one ever kneels to anyone else again.
SMALL ONE. I HAVE WORN THIS LEASH FOR AN AGE. I WILL NOT BEG.

choice.prompt: The lantern hums in your hand.

options.label: Keep the lantern
options.blurb: Rule the road. The wyrm obeys. Your friends will not forgive it.

options.label: Smash the lantern
options.blurb: Free the wyrm, and whatever is inside the glass.

lines: Not for you. For the road.
of course, child. for the road.
And so the Lamplords go on.
The glass! The green is getting out!
...FREE. FREE AND— IT HURTS. IT HURTS.
you broke my house, child. now I need a bigger one.
THERE. IT COMES UP THROUGH THE CELLARS.
The whole capital's crawling. Root-folk in the streets.
The Queen's knights are fighting. Some of them. The rest have roots in them.
WHERE I SEE THEM, I WILL BURN THEM. KEEP YOUR HEADS DOWN.
Kneel. All of you. Kneel to the Undermaw.
Roots, behind the eyes. Knock her down hard enough and they'll let go.
...I could hear it. In my own voice. Telling my knights to kneel.
Its heart is under the Old Crown, the first city. It's buried under this one.
THEN WE GO DOWN. HOLD ON TO MY SCALES, SMALL ONE.
THEY FOLLOW. THINGS WITH WINGS, MADE OF ROOT.
STAND WIDE. I CANNOT BREATHE ON MY OWN BACK.
THE BIG ONE. IT TORE THE WING OFF MY SISTER, LONG AGO.
NOW. INTO THE DARK. FOLD YOUR ARMS.
If I die I'm haunting you. Both of you.
THE HEART IS AT THE BOTTOM. WHEN IT OPENS, I WILL BE THERE.
...THE LAST WYRM BRINGS ME A MEAL. HOW THOUGHTFUL.
It's everywhere. The walls, the floor. We're standing in its mouth.
BEHIND THE EYE. MAKE IT OPEN THE EYE.
I ATE A THOUSAND WYRMS. I WILL NOT CHOKE ON ONE SMALL ONE.
IT IS DONE. FOR THE FIRST TIME IN AN AGE, NOTHING IS HUNGRY UNDER THE WORLD.
Every bell in Halvenmark is ringing.
Rooks, the lot of us, and we saved the kingdom. Someone write that down.
SMALL ONE. WHERE YOU WALK, I WILL FLY. CALL, AND I WILL COME.
She broke the chains in a day. A day.
And she's not hunting the Undermaw. The pit's shut tight. She's hunting us.
Her brood's burning the fields from here to the sea.
SMALL ONE. I KNOW YOUR SMELL NOW. I AM COMING.
That's no wyrmling. That's their mother.
Fighting her brood won't end it. She'll come herself, and nothing on this road can stand against her.
The bell-stones' song is what the old Lamplords used. A whisper of it. Cast a bell big enough, and she might hear the whole song.
The Great Bell. There's a foundry outside the capital that could cast it.
You. The one who woke her. And then chained her. And then lost her.
The last of the Order want the Bell too. To ring her into the ground and keep her there.
The foundry's guardian. Bronze, older than the Order.
It won't let anyone pour the Bell who hasn't beaten it. Old rules.
The Bell's cast. Seven stones in the bronze.
Take it to the tower. I'll hold the Order off. I owe you one wyrm.
She's here. Look at the sky. She's here.
SMALL ONE. COME UP THE TOWER. COME AND ANSWER FOR IT.

bt_intro.place: The Great Bell Tower, in the storm
lines: Her brood's on the stairs. All of them.
Get the Bell to the top. I'll clear the way.
I GAVE YOU MY NAME, AND YOU GAVE ME A CHAIN.
NO MORE CHAINS. NO MORE SMALL ONES WITH LANTERNS AND STONES.
Ossmara, I'm sorry. I'm sorry. But I won't let you burn them.
MY MOTHER SANG IT. UNDER THE HILLS, BEFORE THE HUNGER CAME.
...I AM SO TIRED, SMALL ONE. I WILL LIE DOWN. LET THEM BUILD ROADS ON ME AGAIN.
She's lying down along the hills. Look. She's becoming the hills.
the Queen's walls. thirty feet of stone. how quaint.
...WHERE DO YOU WANT THE FIRE, LAMPLORD.
So. The farm-hand with the leash.
My mother fought the last Lamplord. I suppose it's my turn.
she has no wyrm. we do.
Enough. Halvenhold yields. Spare the city.
kill her. a living queen is a rallying flag.
No. She lives. The city lives.
...you keep saying no to me, child. the lantern is getting hot in your hand.
Barricades on the mill bridge. Pitchforks. Everyone we grew up with.
We're not letting you take Millbrook. Not this one.
I don't want to take it. I want to come home.
you can't go home with me in your hand, child.

ls_boss.place: The village square, by the empty plinth
lines: Remember the bell-stone? I was there the morning they took it. I sent you after it.
Two of us this time, kid. Put it down or get through us.
Your hand. Your hand is burning green.
you are a slow student, child. i am done waiting for you to learn.
home. mine. it's warm, isn't it? green and warm.
a lantern only needs one mind. i was here first.
i taught you every move you know.
You taught me a thief can still be talked to. I'm done talking.
...ONE MIND ON THE LEASH NOW. YOURS.
Halvenmark has a new ruler, then. One with a wyrm.
We'll be on the marsh. When you get tired of it, we'll be there.
I WILL WAIT, LAMPLORD. I AM VERY GOOD AT WAITING.
Heard you smashed it. Heard it right across the marsh.
You put it down. That's all I wanted. Now look at her.
The leash cut deep. She doesn't know friend from foe. She's burning the fells.
CHAINS— NO MORE— GET OFF— GET OFF ME—
Don't kill her. Wear her down. She has to see you.
LANTERN. I SMELL THE LANTERN ON YOU.
I did. I'm sorry it took so long.
SOMETHING CAME OUT OF THE GLASS WHEN IT BROKE. IT WENT TO GREYSPIRE.
THEN WE GO TO GREYSPIRE. I FLY ABOVE. YOU WALK BELOW.
The dead are walking the cloisters. Brothers I buried myself.
Corwen. Thought you'd be on the other side.
He's raising them in green light. I won't serve that. Not again.
children. all my children, come home.
The Lamplord promised. The Lamplord always keeps his promises.
That's Vessa. She drowned off the pier at Saltmere.
Then let's give her some rest.
...cold. I was so cold. Thank you.
He's gone to the Crown. To make a new lantern. From her heart.
Crownhollow, then. Where it all started.
The whole crown's on fire. Green fire.
MY STUDENT. YOU CAME TO WATCH ME WORK.
HE IS TALLER THAN THE ABBEY NOW. HE HAS EATEN EVERY LANTERN IN THE LAND.
Then he's got nothing left to hide in.
i only ever wanted it to be safe. a leash is safe. a cage is safe.
You were afraid. That's all. You were always afraid.
WHEN HE FALTERS, SMALL ONE, STAND CLEAR.
...child. it's dark in here. it's so quiet.
...thank you. I think I'd like to rest.
THE LAST LANTERN IS ASH. THE SKY IS OPEN.
The bells are ringing. All the way back to Millbrook.
No lanterns, no leashes, no Order. Just a road.
AND A WYRM WHO REMEMBERS WHO BROKE THE GLASS.

br_b1: Pale things. Coming up out of the dirt!
br_b2: Hit the callers. They pull more up.
bw_b1: The drowned ones still ring their bells!
bw_b2: ...THEY COME FOR ME. KEEP THEM BACK.
bw_b3: Her children! The wyrmlings are fighting with us!
kw_b2: Bounty on the lantern! A thousand crowns!
hh_b1: BELOW ME, SMALL ONE. STAND CLEAR.
hh_b2: Knights with roots in them! Don't let them grab you!
um_b2: I SEE THE EYE. MAKE IT OPEN.
af_b2: Drakes. Big ones. Watch the fire.
fd_b1: The Order wants the Bell! Hold the yard!
bt_b1: CLIMB, SMALL ONE. CLIMB TO ME.
lv_b1: my old brothers. they live in here too.
lv_b2: every lantern i ever lit. all of it, me.
ww_b1: Her brood's gone wild with her.
ww_b2: Lantern-wisps! Bits of the old glass!
wl_b1: Brother Hale. I'm sorry, Brother Hale.
wl_b2: I SEE THE GREEN. STAND CLEAR.
bc_b2: HE FEEDS ON THE WISPS. BREAK THEM.
sabel_start: Hold still. Glass takes a steady hand.
undermaw_phase2: THE HEART! NOW, SMALL ONE, NOW!
bronze_warden_end: It bows. The foundry is ours.
ossmara_wrath_phase: INTO THE SKY, THEN DOWN ON YOU!
ossmara_wrath_phase2: The Bell! Get to the Bell!
